            order = []
            present = set()
            hits = 0
            misses = 0
        else:
            key = event['key']
            if key in present:

                order.remove(key)
                order.append(key)
            else:

                if len(order) == capacity:
                    present.remove(order.pop(0))
                order.append(key)
                present.add(key)
